note: What a server sends to add to a unit's shield. The header names the unit.

bits.name: physical
bits.note: Set where the shield turns aside physical damage.

bits.name: magical
bits.note: Set where it turns aside magical damage. Both set means either.

bits.name: noFade
bits.note: Set where the shield does not fade.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client ignores these; a server writes zero.

revisions.note: Both physical and magical set adds amount to the shield that takes either kind of damage; one of them, to that kind's shield; neither, to nothing. A negative amount lowers it, and any shield left below 0.001 becomes zero. noFade clear does not restart a fade already stopped.
